parameters.query:
with
prod as (
  select p.id, coalesce(nullif(t.pt, ''), p.name) as nome
  from an_prod_types.products p
  left join an_prod_types.product_translations t on t.id = p.translations_id
),
conv as (
  select bu.id as bu_id, bu.bid_id, bu.user_id as interessado_id, b.creator_id as dono_id, b.product_id,
         min(c.created) as inicio, max(c.created) as ultima, max(c.id) as ultimo_chat_id,
         (array_agg(c.sender_id order by c.id desc))[1] as ultimo_remetente,
         count(*) as n_msgs
  from an_prod_cbc.chats c
  join an_prod_cbc.bid_users bu on bu.id = c.bid_user_id
  join an_prod_cbc.bids b on b.id = bu.bid_id
  where not c.deleted and b.status_id = 1
  group by bu.id, bu.bid_id, bu.user_id, b.creator_id, b.product_id
  having min(c.created) >= $1::timestamp
     and max(c.created) <= (now() at time zone 'utc') - make_interval(days => $2::int)
     and not bool_or(coalesce(c.blocked, false))
),
parada as (
  select 'parada'::text as tipo, ('parada:' || conv.bu_id || ':' || conv.ultimo_chat_id) as chave,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'bid_id', conv.bid_id,
      'produto', (select nome from prod where id = conv.product_id),
      'interessado', jsonb_build_object('id', ci.id, 'nome', ci.nome, 'email', ci.email, 'telefone', ci.telefone),
      'anunciante', jsonb_build_object('id', ca.id, 'nome', ca.nome, 'email', ca.email, 'telefone', ca.telefone),
      'ultimo_remetente', case when conv.ultimo_remetente = conv.dono_id then 'anunciante' else 'interessado' end,
      'inicio', to_char(conv.inicio, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'),
      'ultima_msg', to_char(conv.ultima, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'),
      'dias_parada', floor(extract(epoch from ((now() at time zone 'utc') - conv.ultima)) / 86400)::int,
      'n_msgs', conv.n_msgs,
      'mensagens', (
        select jsonb_agg(m order by m.id) from (
          select c.id,
                 case when c.sender_id = conv.dono_id then 'anunciante' else 'interessado' end as quem,
                 left(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.message, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 400) as texto,
                 to_char(c.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as quando
          from an_prod_cbc.chats c
          where c.bid_user_id = conv.bu_id and not c.deleted
          order by c.id desc limit 6
        ) m)
    ) as dados
  from conv
  left join lateral (
    select u.id, u.email,
      (select up.name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up where up.user_id = u.id and not up.deleted order by up.id limit 1) as nome,
      (select regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')
         from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up
         join an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp on pp.profile_id = up.id
         join an_prod_cbc.phones ph on ph.id = pp.phone_id
         left join an_prod_types.phone_types pt on pt.id = ph.type_id
        where up.user_id = u.id and not ph.deleted
          and length(regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')) between 10 and 13
        order by (pt.name = 'Celular') desc nulls last, ph.id desc
        limit 1) as telefone
    from an_prod_cbc.users u where u.id = conv.interessado_id
  ) ci on true
  left join lateral (
    select u.id, u.email,
      (select up.name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up where up.user_id = u.id and not up.deleted order by up.id limit 1) as nome,
      (select regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')
         from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up
         join an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp on pp.profile_id = up.id
         join an_prod_cbc.phones ph on ph.id = pp.phone_id
         left join an_prod_types.phone_types pt on pt.id = ph.type_id
        where up.user_id = u.id and not ph.deleted
          and length(regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')) between 10 and 13
        order by (pt.name = 'Celular') desc nulls last, ph.id desc
        limit 1) as telefone
    from an_prod_cbc.users u where u.id = conv.dono_id
  ) ca on true
),
proposta as (
  select 'proposta'::text as tipo, ('proposta:' || dp.id) as chave,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'bid_id', d.bid_id,
      'produto', (select nome from prod where id = b.product_id),
      'interessado', jsonb_build_object('id', ci.id, 'nome', ci.nome, 'email', ci.email, 'telefone', ci.telefone),
      'anunciante', jsonb_build_object('id', ca.id, 'nome', ca.nome, 'email', ca.email, 'telefone', ca.telefone),
      'proposta_de', case when dp.creator_id = d.dealer_id then 'interessado' else 'anunciante' end,
      'preco', dp.price,
      'quantidade', dp.quantity,
      'enviada_em', to_char(dp.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'),
      'dias_parada', floor(extract(epoch from ((now() at time zone 'utc') - dp.created)) / 86400)::int,
      'mensagens', (
        select jsonb_agg(m order by m.id) from (
          select c.id,
                 case when c.sender_id = b.creator_id then 'anunciante' else 'interessado' end as quem,
                 left(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.message, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 400) as texto,
                 to_char(c.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as quando
          from an_prod_cbc.chats c
          join an_prod_cbc.bid_users bu on bu.id = c.bid_user_id
          where bu.bid_id = d.bid_id and bu.user_id = d.dealer_id and not c.deleted
          order by c.id desc limit 6
        ) m)
    ) as dados
  from an_prod_cbc.deals d
  join an_prod_cbc.deal_proposals dp on dp.id = d.current_proposal_id
  join an_prod_cbc.bids b on b.id = d.bid_id
  left join lateral (
    select u.id, u.email,
      (select up.name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up where up.user_id = u.id and not up.deleted order by up.id limit 1) as nome,
      (select regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')
         from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up
         join an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp on pp.profile_id = up.id
         join an_prod_cbc.phones ph on ph.id = pp.phone_id
         left join an_prod_types.phone_types pt on pt.id = ph.type_id
        where up.user_id = u.id and not ph.deleted
          and length(regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')) between 10 and 13
        order by (pt.name = 'Celular') desc nulls last, ph.id desc
        limit 1) as telefone
    from an_prod_cbc.users u where u.id = d.dealer_id
  ) ci on true
  left join lateral (
    select u.id, u.email,
      (select up.name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up where up.user_id = u.id and not up.deleted order by up.id limit 1) as nome,
      (select regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')
         from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up
         join an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp on pp.profile_id = up.id
         join an_prod_cbc.phones ph on ph.id = pp.phone_id
         left join an_prod_types.phone_types pt on pt.id = ph.type_id
        where up.user_id = u.id and not ph.deleted
          and length(regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')) between 10 and 13
        order by (pt.name = 'Celular') desc nulls last, ph.id desc
        limit 1) as telefone
    from an_prod_cbc.users u where u.id = d.bid_owner_id
  ) ca on true
  where not d.deleted and d.status_id in (2, 4) and b.status_id = 1
    and dp.created >= $1::timestamp
    and dp.created <= (now() at time zone 'utc') - make_interval(days => $2::int)
    and not exists (select 1 from an_prod_cbc.deal_proposals p2
                    where p2.deal_id = d.id and p2.id > dp.id and not p2.deleted)
    and not exists (select 1 from an_prod_cbc.chats c
                    join an_prod_cbc.bid_users bu on bu.id = c.bid_user_id
                    where bu.bid_id = d.bid_id and bu.user_id = d.dealer_id and not c.deleted
                      and c.created > dp.created and c.sender_id <> dp.creator_id)
)
select * from parada
union all select * from proposta
order by 1, 2

messageValues.message:
Você é um analista de relacionamento do marketplace agrícola AgroNegociar. Recebe o resumo de uma conversa entre um anunciante e um interessado, ou de uma proposta de negócio, que está sem resposta há alguns dias.
Decida se vale avisar a equipe comercial para fazer follow-up.
alertar = false quando a conversa já foi concluída ou perdeu o sentido: o negócio foi combinado ou fechado, alguém desistiu ou disse que não tem interesse, as partes agradeceram e se despediram, mudaram para outro canal, ou são só mensagens de teste ou lixo.
alertar = true quando há algo pendente: pergunta sem resposta, proposta ou preço sem retorno, interesse demonstrado que esfriou, negociação interrompida.
Responda SOMENTE com um objeto JSON válido, sem cercas de código e sem texto antes ou depois, com exatamente estas chaves: alertar (true ou false), resumo (uma frase de até 220 caracteres explicando o que está pendente e o que fazer, em português), urgencia (alta, media ou baixa).
Nunca invente fatos que não estejam nas mensagens.

parameters.content:
## AgroNegociar — Monitor de conversas (IA)
De hora em hora (8h–19h) procura, só entre conversas iniciadas a partir de 08/10/2026:
- **conversa parada**: última mensagem há 3+ dias, anúncio ainda ativo;
- **proposta sem resposta**: proposta aberta há 3+ dias sem contraproposta nem mensagem do outro lado.

Uma IA (gpt-4o-mini via OpenRouter) lê as últimas mensagens e decide se vale avisar (ignora conversa concluída). A IA NÃO recebe e-mail nem telefone.
Cada conversa é avisada uma vez; se alguém responder e ela parar de novo, é avisada de novo.
